description: Keep only films whose replacement cost is strictly more than 20.99, so films costing exactly 20.99 are left out.

c.request: Taking 20.99 as the cutoff for a film being expensive to replace (`replacement_cost`), look only at the expensive films and group them by `rating`. For each rating, show the rating, the average `length` (ignoring missing values), and the average per film of `rental_rate` divided by `rental_duration` (ignoring missing values). Leave all values unrounded. Keep only films whose replacement cost is strictly more than 20.99, so films costing exactly 20.99 are left out.
c.sql: SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS average_length, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS average_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating

a.request: For films whose `replacement_cost` is more than 20.99, group by `rating` and show, for each rating, the rating, the average `length` (ignoring missing values), and the average per film of `rental_rate` divided by `rental_duration` (ignoring missing values). Leave all values unrounded.
a.sql: SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating

d.request: For each rating among films with `replacement_cost > 20.99`, show the rating, the unrounded average of non-null `length`, and the unrounded average of each film’s `rental_rate / rental_duration`, excluding null ratios.
d.sql: SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating

b.request: For films with `replacement_cost > 20.99`, group by `rating` and report the rating, the unrounded average of non-null `length` values, and the unrounded average of each film’s `rental_rate / rental_duration`, excluding null ratios.
b.sql: SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating
